تنتدبوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَدِبُوا (tantadibū) /tan.ta.di.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
# تُنْتَدَبُوا (tuntadabū) /tun.ta.da.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
